reason: Closes #121. Eight more packages join the scoped strict-mypy override in pyproject.toml and the Makefile's gate line: ingest, analytics, doctrine, language, skills, instructions, engagement, web — bringing strict coverage from 5 to 13 of 18 packages. Re-measured 2026-09-17 with the issue's own method (one package added to a copied override at a time, counting only `^nora/<pkg>/.*: error:`): ingest, analytics, doctrine, language and skills were already zero; instructions (2) and engagement (9) matched the issue's 2026-09-11 numbers exactly; web was 50, one more than the issue's 49 (six days of drift). All 61 errors were `[type-arg]` (a bare `dict`/`list`/`tuple` missing its generic parameters) — fixed by adding the type arguments, no behaviour change anywhere. Positive control: injecting an untyped function into nora/ingest/pipeline.py and nora/doctrine/loader.py (two of the five packages that measured zero) produced a `[no-untyped-def]` error in both, then reverted — the zero is the checker actually looking, not a checker that isn't running. Nothing a member of a room can observe.
